name: Alessandro Mancini
bio: Alessandro's motorsport journey began in the workshops of Modena, assisting his uncle, a seasoned mechanic for Ferrari. He quickly developed a keen understanding of vehicle dynamics and a passion for racing. He transitioned from hands-on technical roles to team management, honing his ability to orchestrate complex operations. Alessandro believes in fostering a data-driven approach while trusting the gut feeling of experienced team members. His ability to bridge the gap between technical expertise and strategic oversight makes him a valuable asset to GCK Motorsport. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his knack for spotting hidden potential in both drivers and engineers.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alessandro is of average height with a slightly weathered face that reflects years spent at the racetrack.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and sketches.
Insists on having a strong espresso before every race.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
